title: Aeroworks SMP
description: Aeroworks SMP is a NeoForge 1.21.1 server for maximum Aeronautics interaction.
body:
# Aeroworks SMP

## Make sure you allocate at least 6GB of RAM

[Discord Link](https://discord.gg/vNNBUVCbD3)

[Server Map](https://aero.gguppy.net/map/#world:-1530:0:653:7389:0:0:0:0:perspective)

Aeroworks is a NeoForge 1.21.1 multiplayer server for players who want to build, fly, trade, explore, and engineer large projects together.

The server is built around Create: Aeronautics, which lets players design and use airships and other moving contraptions. The main goal of Aeroworks is to give players a long term world where air travel, transport routes, towns, factories, rail systems, and shared infrastructure matter.

Players should join Aeroworks if they want a multiplayer Minecraft world that develops over time through community projects. You can build an airship, connect settlements, move goods, create factories, set up trade routes, explore improved structures, or work with other players on large engineering builds.

The server includes supporting mods such as Create: Big Cannons, Create: Propulsion, Create: Radars, CC: Sable, Vista, Mekanism, and Oritech. These add more options for automation, machinery, power, navigation, ship systems, and advanced production chains.

Exploration is expanded with Tectonic, WWOO, YUNG’s Better structures, and End Remastered. Terrain generation and many vanilla style structures are improved, while End Remastered makes reaching the End a longer server wide progression goal instead of something players rush immediately.

Aeroworks also includes multiplayer quality of life features such as claims, maps, voice chat, and social tools. These are included to make cooperation, travel, trading, and settlement building easier.

Important information before joining: Aeroworks requires the server’s NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack to connect. This is a multiplayer server experience, so gameplay may involve other players, shared infrastructure, claims, trading, towns, alliances, and community projects. Roleplay is welcome but not required.

Aeroworks is best for players who want a Create: Aeronautics server focused on airships, logistics, exploration, factories, transport networks, and a world shaped by its community.
